Cyclone Barun lashes Bangladesh coast, hundreds of thousands flee

Cyclone Barun hit the coast of Bangladesh near Cox's Bazar with winds of 120 km/h, forecasters said, as waves swept over embankments and cut roads to several coastal towns.

A local relief official told reporters: "We have never seen the water rise this fast." Aid groups said they were preparing food and clean water for displaced families.
